name: @balakumar.dev/mcpkit
stderr:
Usage: mcpkit [options] [command]

Turn any MCP server into CLI commands + lightweight agent skills

Options:
  -V, --version                            output the version number
  -h, --help                               display help for command

Commands:
  install [options] <server-spec>          Install MCP server tools as agent skills
  call [options] <server> <tool> [params]  Call a tool on a registered MCP server
  list [server]                            List registered servers or tools on a server
  remove [options] <name>                  Remove an installed MCP server
  update [name]                            Re-discover tools and regenerate skill files
  sync [options] [name]                    Sync registry — generate missing skill files using saved agent preferences
  view [options] <name>                    Show full config for a registered server
  edit [options] <name>                    Modify config for a registered server
  auth [options] <name>                    Manage OAuth authentication for a server
  agents [options]                         Show supported agents and configure default skill targets
  runtime                                  Manage persistent stdio runtimes
  help [command]                           display help for command
